name: Special 1 - Beer Bottle Throw
prompt: One non-looping side-view special move, facing RIGHT. Start in the supplied empty-handed guard, feet planted. Twist the chest slightly toward camera into the 'Lancio birra' windup: RIGHT throwing arm bent back beside the head, hand on the LEFT side of the picture; LEFT aiming arm extended toward the RIGHT at shoulder height. ONE amber glass beer bottle with a cream-and-gold label materializes upright in the rear hand. Perform exactly ONE overarm throw toward the RIGHT using that same arm. At one clear release moment, the bottle disappears completely at the fingertips. Follow through with an EMPTY hand, then return to the supplied guard. One windup, one throw, one recovery. Preserve Torpe's face, long hair, black AC/DC shirt, black shorts, sandals and proportions. Fixed camera and stable ground line. Keep the entire body, hands and held bottle inside the frame, with room above the raised hand.

gameplay.input: down, down-forward, forward + LP/MP/SP; 600 ms tolerance

review.notes: Runtime crops the top 40 pixels of native frames 33/34 to remove the baked flying bottle. AtlasTexture margins preserve the 512x512 virtual canvas and character registration; source PNG unchanged.
